A számla adatait az adózási és bizonylatmegőrzési kötelezettségek teljesítésére kezeljük (GDPR 6. cikk (1) c)). Hírlevelet csak külön, önkéntes hozzájárulás alapján küldünk (GDPR 6. cikk (1) a)). Az e-mail-címet, nyelvet, hozzájárulás idejét és forrását kezeljük. A hozzájárulás bármikor visszavonható az ügyfélszolgálati e-mailen; ez a rendelést nem érinti.

Orders and payment

Names, email addresses, telephone numbers, delivery and billing addresses, business tax numbers where applicable, products, prices and transaction references are used to fulfil orders and communicate with you. Legal basis: performance of a contract, Article 6(1)(b) GDPR. Required details are necessary to fulfil your order. We do not store card details.
Quotations and uploaded images

Contact details, choices, text and images supplied for custom candles are used to prepare quotations and fulfil accepted orders under Article 6(1)(b) GDPR. Images are not published or used for advertising without separate permission. Only upload images you are entitled to use.
Invoices, complaints and withdrawal

Invoice data is processed to meet tax and record-keeping obligations (Article 6(1)(c) GDPR). Names, contact details, references, contents and timestamps of complaints and withdrawal notices are used to resolve the matter, meet legal obligations and, where necessary, defend legal claims (Article 6(1)(b), (c) and (f)).
Newsletter

Newsletters require separate, voluntary consent (Article 6(1)(a) GDPR). We process your email address, language and the time and source of consent. You may withdraw consent at any time by emailing customer service, without affecting your order.
Service providers and recipients

Hosting, database, local image storage and hosting-based email: Rackhost Zrt. (https://www.rackhost.hu/). Invoicing: KBOSS.hu Kft., Számlázz.hu (https://www.szamlazz.hu/adatvedelem/), including legally required reporting to the Hungarian tax authority NAV. Payments: Barion Payment Zrt., an independent controller (https://www.barion.com/hu/adatvedelmi-tajekoztato/). The delivery carrier receives the name, address and contact details needed for delivery; the particular carrier is identified in shipping information.
Internal notifications and Gmail

Order notifications are sent to hinfinicandles@hinfinicandles.hu and separately copied to hinfinicandles@gmail.com. This places a copy in Google’s email service, which may involve processing outside the EEA. Details and safeguards: https://policies.google.com/privacy. Customer email addresses are not disclosed to other customers.
Retention

Data needed for orders and legal claims is generally retained for five years after fulfilment; complaint records and responses for three years. Invoices follow the seller’s applicable tax record-retention rules; where accounting retention applies, the period is at least eight years. Unaccepted custom quotations and their images are needed for no more than one year. Newsletter data is retained until consent is withdrawn. An ongoing dispute or legal obligation may extend retention of necessary records.
Browser storage and tracking

The basket (hi_cart_v1) and language (hi_lang) remain in local browser storage until cleared and support functionality you request. Cookie preferences are retained for six months. The optional Barion Pixel loads only with separate permission; change your choice on the Cookie settings page. Newsletter consent is separate. The shop does not make automated profile-based decisions with legal effects.
External fonts, images and security data

Rendering the site may request Google Fonts and, depending on the image URL configured for a product, external image services. These providers receive IP addresses and browser details with the request. The purpose is to display requested content, based on our legitimate interest in presenting the shop (Article 6(1)(f) GDPR). To limit abuse, we also process an identifier derived from the IP address, timestamps and attempt counts on the same legal basis. These are not used for marketing. You may object to processing based on legitimate interests.
Your data protection rights

You may request access, correction and, where applicable, erasure, restriction and portability, and object to processing based on legitimate interests. You may withdraw consent without affecting earlier lawful processing. Contact hinfinicandles@hinfinicandles.hu; we normally respond within one month. You can complain to NAIH, 1055 Budapest, Falk Miksa utca 9–11., Hungary; postal address: 1363 Budapest, Pf. 9.; https://www.naih.hu/. Judicial remedies are also available.

en: Necessary storage

Local browser storage supports your basket and language choice. You can clear it in your browser. Your privacy choice is stored as hi_privacy_v1 for six months. Administration login data is needed only for the administrator’s session.
Optional Barion Pixel

The optional Barion Pixel supports payment-fraud detection. It loads only if enabled by the operator and accepted by you. Rejecting it does not prevent shopping. We do not send marketing Full Pixel events. Barion explains its identifiers and retention at https://www.barion.com/hu/adatvedelmi-tajekoztato/. Withdrawing permission reloads the page and prevents further loading; existing third-party cookies can also be cleared through your browser.
